supporting_observations.claim: During the alert period, WS-LMARTINS-01 made repeated connections to the internal proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080, with examples spaced roughly five minutes apart.

Several of those proxy connections have similar byte counts, including about 9.7 KB sent and 43.5 KB received; this could fit recurring update checks but does not identify the application or destination.

The inventory lists PixelForge Suite as approved and says its updater checks for updates about every five minutes, making it a plausible explanation for the cadence, but the available records do not tie these connections to that updater.

Near the end of the review window, the workstation made SMB connections to DC-NWD-01 under the System process and its machine account; the records do not show what share or activity those sessions involved.

Outside the interval, proxy records show ordinary browser requests to Google Calendar and later SharePoint/OneDrive-related services, but these do not establish the nature of the periodic connections during the alert window.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports a collection outage for WS-LMARTINS-01 winsec and Sysmon, and for the proxy, from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. Endpoint process attribution and proxy destination details are therefore unavailable for the core alert interval.
Zeek connection records show connections to the internal proxy, not the external HTTPS hostnames or content involved.
No supplied record identifies the process responsible for the repeated connections during the outage.

Which external hostname or service the periodic connections reached.
Whether the traffic carried malicious content, command-and-control data, or sensitive data.
Whether the SMB sessions to DC-NWD-01 involved administration, routine system activity, or another action.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-LMARTINS-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, including process image, command line, user, and connection correlation.
Recover proxy logs for the interval, including CONNECT hostnames, authenticated user, user agent, and byte counts.
Obtain Zeek TLS/SNI or equivalent destination metadata for the periodic connections.
Review DC-NWD-01 SMB and authentication audit details to identify the share and activity associated with the 14:10 and 14:18 sessions.
